h1_base.note: Single gameweek, exactly as it runs now.

h1_appearance.note: Single gameweek trained without appearance points, re-added to score.

h1_mw.note: Single gameweek, rows weighted by minutes played.

hz_base.note: Horizon as it runs now: every anchor, so windows overlap.

h1_poisson.note: Single gameweek, poisson loss on the raw rate.

hz_mw.note: Horizon, windows weighted by minutes played.

hz_deleak.note: Horizon with non-overlapping windows (1-5, 6-10, ...): no shared labels.

h1_poisson_mw.note: Single gameweek, poisson with exposure weights (the textbook form).

hz_poisson.note: Horizon, poisson loss on the raw rate.

hz_subsample.note: Horizon, overlapping windows subsampled to the de-leaked row count.
